themes.name: Light Through Stone
themes.description: Tadao Ando's Church of the Light recast as graphic poster — raw concrete mass split by a single blade of dawn gold, every surface textured with material weight.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: A blade of gold cuts concrete. The cross is shadow. The light is the point.

themes.name: Saffron Interference
themes.description: A typographically charged dawn composition where condensed amber headlines crackle against misty morning surfaces — cozy warmth interrupted by one electric surprise.

props.text: Condensed amber headlines crackle at first light — warm fog split by one electric interruption.

themes.name: Amber & Indigo
themes.description: A dawn index card — warm amber light pooling against deep indigo structure, like a Tokyo side street caught between night and morning.

props.text: Dawn pooling on index cards. Tokyo side-street amber bleeding into the last cold hour of indigo night — structured, warm, unresolved.
Source Serif 4 — the body holds its warmth

themes.name: Shaft & Stone
themes.description: Tadao Ando's raw concrete meets a single blade of Scandinavian dawn light — heavy material surfaces fractured by one luminous gesture.

props.text: Concrete doesn't apologize. Neither does light. This is the moment one blade of Scandinavian dawn finds a seam in raw brutalist mass — heavy, still, luminous.
Material surface. Singular light. The architecture of restraint.

themes.name: Vespers & Vellum
themes.description: Dawn light filtering through library windows onto aged vellum — the quiet reverence of a scholarly morning, warm concrete meeting soft gold.

props.text: Dawn arrives through leaded glass. The vellum already knows what the day will ask of it. Warm concrete, soft gold — a scholar's hour made interface.
The Quiet Reverence of a Scholarly Morning

themes.name: Nave & Graphite
themes.description: Tadao Ando's concrete chapel transposed to print — a single blade of warm light cuts through heavy shadow, all restraint and spiritual weight.

props.text: Concrete is honest. Light earns its place. Every margin is load-bearing.
Tadao Ando in type. Restraint is the ornament.

themes.name: Chalk & Frequency
themes.description: Dawn light through a concrete slit — soft warmth breaking against structured weight, where heavy type anchors an otherwise breath-light surface.

props.text: Dawn breaks through concrete — warmth pressed against structure, breath-light surfaces held down by type that refuses to float.
